projects.title: Ultra-High Bandwidth Continuous Time ΔΣ ADC Design
highlights: Proposed a **digital logic based ELD compensation scheme** for ELD>1 clock cycles for CT-DSM and verified logic through simulation both in MATLAB and ideal blocks in Cadence.
Targeting a **200MHz bandwidth** and **68dB SNDR** at a sampling rate of 9.6GHz.
Currently designing the modulator in **GF 22nm FDSOI** technology node.
This project is part of my final year undergraduate thesis project.

Advisor: **[Prof. Sarvana Kumar M.](https://iitr.ac.in/Departments/Electronics%20and%20Communication%20Engineering%20Department/People/Faculty/100969.html)**, Assistant Professor, ECE Department, IIT Roorkee

projects.title: Design of a 4th order CT Butterworth Filter in Cadence Virtuoso
projects.organization: ECL-538 : Mixed Signal Circuit Design course
highlights: Implemented the filter as a cascade of two single-ended Tow Thomas Biquad filters.
Each stage of filter utilised a previously designed two-stage Miller compensated OTA, designed using gm/Id technique. Entire design was carried out in SCL 180nm pdk.

projects.title: FRUC detection using periodic properties of edge intensity
highlights: Implemented algorithms for detection of video **Frame-Rate Up-Conversion (FRUC)** using periodic variation of frame edge intensity.
Drop in frame edge intensity was used as a measure to detect upconversion.
